sv.title: DN Debatt. ”Ivo offrar våra sjuka barn på principens altare”
sv.summary: DN DEBATT. Boendet Safiren har varit livsavgörande för våra barn. Tills nu. Ivo vill stänga det av principiella skäl. Men budskapet har gått fram, regionen lär ju göra rätt i framtiden.

en.title: DN Debate. "Ivo sacrifices our sick children on the altar of principle"
en.summary: DN DEBATE. The Safiren housing has been vital for our children. Until now. Ivo wants to shut it down for principled reasons. But the message has got through, the region will presumably do the right thing in future.
